Hi Priyom,

We signed up for a trial yesterday and Marissa from your team suggested arranging a short technical triage before the full demo. We're evaluating Redwood to replace our existing inference layer for product recommendations and want to confirm a few things before committing time for a longer walkthrough:

- Typical end-to-end latency when serving a small batched rerank workload (B2S 64 tokens, 4 concurrent requests)
- Private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) and what evidence you can provide for data isolation
- Whether KV caching can be pinned to a customer-specific pool for cold-start-sensitive flows

Would a 15-minute slot work today or tomorrow? Prefer mornings PDT. If helpful, we can share a short architecture diagram.

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Senior Engineering Manager
